label: ECOSENSE · LT52 · 2025-11-04
subtitle: Deciduous position · HDHP-LAI available
description: Real UAV LiDAR point cloud of the ECOSENSE forest at reference position LT52 on 2025-11-04. The models were trained only on synthetic stands and are applied unchanged, so their predictions are uncalibrated. Their mean LAI over the 109 prediction columns of the canopy cylinder (radius 10.9 m) is compared with the field reference HDHP-LAI (0.54 on this date).

frame.description: x east and y north of reference position LT52; z above the ground at the position (DTM there = 0). Heights are relative to that ground, not above sea level.

layers.label: Feature-MLP
layers.notes: Trained only on synthetic stands: the training partition of the training set (51 stands, foliation ≤ 75 %) with the height shift of the tallest stands (labels up to 44–46 m). LAI cap: no LAI above the highest height bin of the prediction column with at least three returns. The total LAI of a prediction column is the sum of its profile.

calibration.description: OLS fit of HDHP-LAI on the mean LAI of the canopy cylinder over the 600 observations at all 24 reference positions, evaluated on the same observations.

layers.label: Random Forest
layers.notes: Trained only on synthetic stands: the training partition of the training set (51 stands, foliation ≤ 75 %) with the height shift of the tallest stands (labels up to 44–46 m). The Random Forest consists of two models, one for the total LAI and one for the profile; the profile is rescaled to the total LAI of each prediction column (all zeros where it sums to 0).

references.label: HDHP-LAI
references.description: Long-term harmonized DHP LAI (HDHP-LAI), the field reference of the evaluation: the leaf-off woody minimum of each season subtracted (at the mixed/coniferous positions the mean of the deciduous positions), linearly interpolated to the LiDAR acquisition date without extrapolation.

baselines.label: Gap fraction

calibration.description: OLS fit of HDHP-LAI on the mean LAI of the canopy cylinder over the 600 observations at all 24 reference positions, evaluated on the same observations.

baselines.description: The parametric baseline, which requires no training: a Beer–Lambert inversion of the gap fraction in the canopy cylinder (radius 10.9 m) around the reference position, from all returns without ground removal; returns below 1.8 m above the terrain count as gaps. PAI_eff = −ln(gap fraction) / k with k = G / cos θ, G = 0.5 and θ the mean absolute scan angle of the returns; LAI = (1 − α) / Ω · PAI_eff with Ω = 0.85 and α = 0.35. Total LAI only, no vertical profile.
